answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the willow accrues. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest falcon a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. So a vertex of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1ge3x.
